title: Tiny Feather but ok
text:
Tiny Feather but ok. [[VIDEOID:31684cfe6bdc50621e39582cc142020]] I only wanted sage so the rest is just extra for me. The feather they include is a joke. You’d be better off finding a bigger, better, one outside on the ground.
Wood & sweet grass samples included but no information about using them.??
Besides the feather, I'm pleased.
